summary: 11 film announcements, 13 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Live 2 Die
film.talent: Josh Bowman, Ron Perlman, Esai Morales
film.announcement: Josh Bowman, Ron Perlman and Esai Morales cast to star in the film.

film.title: Possession
film.talent: Madeline Brewer, Emory Cohen, Nicholas Alexander Chavez
film.announcement: Madeline Brewer, Emory Cohen and Nicholas Alexander Chavez join the cast of Paramount's Possession.

film.title: Tormented Souls
film.studio: ZQ Entertainment, Prime Universe, Longevity Pictures
film.announcement: ZQ Entertainment, Prime Universe and Longevity Pictures acquire film and TV rights to the horror video game Tormented Souls.

film.title: Thud
film.talent: Sarah Michelle Gellar, Rudy Pankow, Steve Agee, Karan Soni
film.announcement: Grim Reaper-Devil romance film Thud starring Sarah Michelle Gellar and Rudy Pankow adds seven cast members including Steve Agee and Karan Soni.

film.title: Show of Hands
film.announcement: Frank Grillo to lead political kidnapping comedy Show of Hands directed by P.J. Pesce.

film.title: Richard Pryor
film.announcement: Richard Pryor biopic based on daughter Elizabeth Stordeur Pryor's memoir Something We Said is in development from Latigo Films and Inaugural Entertainment.

film.title: The Conjuring: First Communion
film.talent: Charles Parnell, Marta Kessler, Caleb Dolden
film.announcement: The Conjuring: First Communion rounds out cast with Charles Parnell, Marta Kessler and Caleb Dolden.

film.title: American Summer
film.announcement: Family comedy American Summer starring Steve Guttenberg and Christie Brinkley lands release.

film.title: The Master and Margarita
film.announcement: The Master and Margarita adaptation gets long-awaited U.S. theatrical release after legal battle.

film.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
film.announcement: Michael B. Jordan directs and stars himself in The Thomas Crown Affair remake.

film.title: Ernie & Emma
film.announcement: Bruce Campbell to bring Ernie & Emma on nationwide Alamo Drafthouse tour this fall.

tv.title: Task
tv.announcement: Martha Plimpton and Silvia Dionicio to return for season 2 of HBO's Task.

tv.title: Chad Powers
tv.announcement: Chad Powers season 2 gets fall release date with Glen Powell aiming to lead South Georgia Catfish to college football playoffs.

tv.title: Reacher
tv.talent: Jay Baruchel, Kevin Durand, Amanda Ip, Ciara Bravo
tv.announcement: Jay Baruchel, Kevin Durand, Amanda Ip and Ciara Bravo join Reacher for season 5.

tv.title: Young Sherlock
tv.talent: Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams, Aidan Gillen
tv.announcement: Young Sherlock adds Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams and Aidan Gillen for season 2 while setting returning cast.

tv.title: Robin Hood
tv.announcement: Graeme Thomas King upped to series regular for season 2 of Robin Hood as Prince John.

tv.title: The Earliest Show
tv.talent: Chris Pratt, Lamorne Morris, Sarah Silverman
tv.announcement: The Earliest Show announces 14 guest stars including Chris Pratt, Lamorne Morris and Sarah Silverman.

tv.title: Thunder Road
tv.announcement: AMC NASCAR series Thunder Road casts Silo star Shane McRae.

tv.title: Chicago Fire
tv.announcement: Chicago Fire original cast member Joe Miñoso leaving in season 15 of the NBC drama.

tv.title: American Horror Story
tv.announcement: American Horror Story season 13 brings together all previous seasons in what Ryan Murphy describes as like the Avengers.

tv.title: American Idol
tv.announcement: American Idol renewed for season 10 on ABC, marking the 25th season overall.

tv.title: The Daily Show
tv.announcement: The Daily Show sets 30th anniversary podcast hosted by the news team.

tv.title: Best in Class
tv.announcement: Comcast's Xfinity launches creator reality series Best in Class hosted by Katie Feeney.

tv.title: Myron Bolitar
tv.announcement: Harlan Coben bringing Myron Bolitar to Netflix with filming underway.
